chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُولَوَيْهَ وَالْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ بَنْدَارٍ الْقُمِّيُّ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الطَّيَالِسِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِنَّانَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. Qulawayh and al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Bundar al-Qummi from Sa’d b. Abdallah from Muhammad b. Khalid al-Tayalisi from Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Najran from Ibn Sinan who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: إِنَّا أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ صَادِقُونَ لَا نَخْلُو مِنْ كَاذِبٍ يَكْذِبُ عَلَيْنَا فَيَسْقُطُ صِدْقُنَا بِكَذِبِهِ عَلَيْنَا عِنْدَ النَّاسِ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَصْدَقَ الْبَرِيَّةِ لَهْجَةً وَكَانَ مُسَيْلَمَةُ يَكْذِبُ عَلَيْهِ، وَكَانَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَصْدَقَ مَنْ بَرَأَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَكَانَ الَّذِي يَكْذِبُ عَلَيْهِ وَيَعْمَلُ فِي تَكْذِيبِ صِدْقِهِ بِمَا يَفْتَرِي عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْكَذِبِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَبْإٍ لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ، وَكَانَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَدْ ابْتُلِيَ بِالْمُخْتَارِ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَارِثَ الشَّامِيَّ وَبَيَانًا، فَقَالَ: كَانَا يَكْذِبَانِ عَلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ وَبَزِيعًا وَالسَّرِيَّ وَأَبَا الْخَطَّابِ وَمُعَمَّرًا وَبَشَّارًا الشَّعِيرِيَّ وَحَمَزَةَ الْبَرْبَرِيَّ وَصَائِدَ النَّهْدِيِّ فَقَالَ: لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ إِنَّا لَا نَخْلُو مِنْ كَاذِبٍ أَوْ عَاجِزِ الرَّأْيِ، كَفَانَا اللَّهُ مُؤْنَةَ كُلِّ كَاذِبٍ وَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ حَرَّ الْحَدِيدِ

translations.en: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: We the Ahl al-Bayt are always truthful but do not lack a liar lying against us and degrading our truthfulness by his lies to the masses. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was the most truthful of people in speech but Musaylama used to lie about him. The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was the most truthful of men created by Allah after the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), but the one who used to lie against him and work in negating his truthfulness by forging things against him was Abdallah b. Saba – may Allah curse him. Abu Abdillah al-Husayn b. Ali (peace be upon him) was put to trial [afflicted] by al-Mukhtar. Then Abu Abdillah mentioned al-Harith the Syrian and Bayan [b. Sam’an] and said: they used to lie upon Ali b. al-Husayn (peace be upon him). Then he mentioned al-Mughira b. Sa’id, Bazi`, al-Sarri, Aba al-Khattab, Muammar, Bashshar the barley seller, Hamza the Berber and Sa’id al-Nahdi and said: May Allah curse them – we do not lack a liar or one deficient in intellect [tormenting us]. May Allah suffice us against ever needing the help of any liar and may Allah make them taste the heat of the sword [put them to the sword].

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the theological necessity of the 'Kadhdhabun' (liars) in preserving the distinct identity of the Ahl al-Bayt, noting that their fabricated narrations serve to test the sincerity of the masses. By citing historical precedents from the Prophet, Ali, and Husayn, alongside specific figures like Ibn Saba and al-Mukhtar, the Imam highlights the continuous struggle between authentic tradition and opportunistic fabrication. This tradition underscores the Shia concept of 'Tawatur' (mass transmission) amidst noise, affirming that the Imams' truthfulness remains intact despite the confusion caused by these detractors.
en.seo_question: Who are the notable liars that fabricated narrations against the Ahl al-Bayt according to Imam al-Sadiq?

key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ: Ahl al-Bayt (the Family of the Prophet)
key_terms.مُسَيْلَمَةُ: Musaylama (the liar prophet who opposed the Prophet Muhammad)
key_terms.عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَبْإٍ: Abdallah b. Saba (the fabricator who opposed Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.الْمُخَرَّ: Al-Mukhtar (the claimant who used Husayn's name)
key_terms.أَبُو الْخَطَّابِ: Abu al-Khattab (a prominent liar in Shia history)
key_terms.حَرَّ الْحَدِيدِ: Heat of the sword (metaphor for death/execation)
